conditions: Root explicitly reviews and completes this permit, then hashes the exact new permit file in the actual V3 run directory.
Starting the finisher requires both --permit and --permit-sha256; this template does not authorize execution.
Only a controller with DONE/PARTIAL and ended_at_utc plus a ledger with no RUNNING phase can trigger final analysis.
The final release will bind this permit SHA, final analyzer/finisher source SHA, final closed ledger SHA and closed controller-state SHA.
Polling, analysis and optional Git delivery stop at the existing V3 deadline, with no retry or additional compute budget.
Git commit/push requires both allow_git_push=true here and explicit --push at launch; otherwise only actual science evidence and the new document are produced.
Only new closed V3 artifacts and the designated new document can enter the Git commit; all shared-index, branch, size and source guards must pass.
Actual commit/push SHA and status are saved only under ignored outputs/ delivery records, not backfilled into the scientific report.
